**[P2] Keep the local carrier separate from `process.env`**

This passes the same object as invocation metadata and environment. Existing callers are explicitly allowed to pass `process.env`, so a user-defined environment variable named `xRayTraceId` is now interpreted as an invocation-local header. If malformed, it suppresses a valid `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID`, making this helper return the ARN-derived ID while the default plugin still uses the environment Root and splits wrapper spans from the SDK trace. Accept the local header through a separate parameter or discriminated carrier object, preserving the legacy path that reads only `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID`, and add a regression test for this collision.
